notes.title: We summon you to our divine sanctuary on Discord!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307405/eaf3be9393891263c09bb313a0f6144cfbef6fc8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]O glorious Knowledge Seekers, heed the voice of the unparalleled Landelion, Perfect, Sublime, and Magnificent Writer! The most exalted luminary of EONIA REVELATIONS![/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]I, the supreme narrator of epics, summon you to our divine sanctuary on Discord, where the chronicles of our creation gleam like an eternal dawn and the most sublime secrets await to dazzle you. Dare to pose your questions, let your curiosities shine like constellations before my genius, and join other mortals in this assembly worthy of my presence. I, Landelion, in my infinite humility, await you to illuminate your minds with my peerless wisdom! Perhaps in this way, my dear mortals, one day, with immense, immense effort, you may attain my absolute perfection![/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/bGqXDPB6"]https://discord.gg/bGqXDPB6[/url][/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]And I, Juan, thank you for your incredible support. Let us forge this epic fantasy and sci-fi adventure together! You’re going to love it![/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]Juan from GEOMETRIC BYTES[/p]

notes.title: THE PLAYTEST ENDS THIS MONDAY!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307405/2c0b8fdb8f5b753c51d703351f3ade7d65fc3a26.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello, Knowledge Seekers![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]REMEMBER: THE PLAYTEST ENDS ON MONDAY![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who wanted to explore the world of EONIA REVELATIONS in this playtest! Your feedback and enthusiasm are amazing![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]I hope you’ll join me for a long time in shaping this fascinating fantasy and sci-fi adventure that will surprise you.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Juan from GEOMETRIC BYTES[/p]

notes.title: PLAYTEST NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307405/236740cc2ec559deec2f4d1e1357508fecb2d8e1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for joining the development of this stunning fantasy and sci-fi adventure! EONIA Revelations is not just a game; it’s an immersive journey into a beautiful world you’ll hopefully always want to return to.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]REMEMBER:[/p][p]For an optimal experience, please make sure to check the requirements and update your video drivers.[/p][p]Also, please keep in mind that playtests are for a product still in early development, so encountering bugs and all sorts of issues is very likely.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for your support, and I hope you’ll join me for a long time in shaping this fascinating fantasy and sci-fi adventure that will surprise you.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Juan from GEOMETRIC BYTES[/p]

notes.title: BIG ANNOUNCEMENT!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307405/1ff8323921a98d8f01a6269cb6dc95e799b2351d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]BIG ANNOUNCEMENT![/b][/h1][p][/p][p][/p][p]Hello, Knowledge Seekers!
[/p][p]The first playtest of [i]EONIA REVELATIONS[/i] starts next Tuesday! Join the development and help me shape this beautiful fantasy and sci-fi adventure!
After nearly three years of developing the game solo, it’s finally time for you to try it out with the first private playtest of the game.
This is a moment of great anxiety and nerves for me, and I hope you find [i]EONIA REVELATIONS[/i] fun, relaxing, and, above all, that it awakens all those emotions I’ve poured into this cozy world with so much care.
[i]EONIA Revelations[/i] is not just a game; it’s an immersive journey into a beautiful world you’ll hopefully always want to return to… [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Sign up now![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for your support, and I hope you’ll join me in shaping this fascinating fantasy and sci-fi adventure that will surprise you.
[/p][p]H Juan M Silvetti[/p][p][/p][p][/p]
